You want to know about screen capture, eh? Well, on this system, we use X11, so screen capture is handled by the Xorg server. We have X11 forwarding enabled, which allows you to capture the screen remotely, but only if you have the necessary permissions, of course.

If you want to capture the screen, you can use tools like `xwd`, `x11grab`, or `scrot`. These commands will capture the entire screen or a specific window and save it as an image file. We also have a few other tools like `ffmpeg` and `gm` that can capture video or images from the screen. 

For instance, I can use `xwd -root -out screenshot.xwd` to capture the entire screen and save it as `screenshot.xwd`. Or, if I want to capture a specific window, I can use `xwd -id <window_id> -out screenshot.xwd`. You can get the window_id by using the `xwininfo` command.
